chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"The limit of the grave is to the collarbone."
ai.seo_question: How deep should a grave be according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prescribed measure for the depth of a grave. It serves as a concise jurisprudential instruction within the rulings related to burial and funeral practices.
